title: Bounded per-pixel Cholesky and exact-rational LU factors with matrix transpose alias

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name inventory only; not full API, argument, numerical or project migration compatibility

implementation.compiler: Named logical L or L/U/P array bands share one immutable matrix producer. Select one factor before ordinary array algebra; row-major output and explicit nested Float32/Double stages preserved. matrixTranspose reuses the pinned same-signature arrayTranspose layout without arithmetic.

wire.output_order: L then U then P, each row-major; Cholesky emits L only

numeric.cholesky: Exact binary64 symmetry; rounded binary64 L factors with exact original-scale residual products. Positive computed residual pivots required. Residual converts to Decimal losslessly; only sqrt and exact quotient division use 50-digit half-even context before binary64 rounding. This is a computed-pivot policy, not an exact mathematical positive-definiteness certificate.
numeric.LU: Exact binary64-rational inputs, first-maximum absolute pivots, prior L-column swaps, exact Fraction/BigFraction elimination and final one-step binary64 nearest-even rounding. P*A=L*U before output rounding; returned factors satisfy it only within rounding accuracy. Exactly singular [[3,3],[1,1]] is masked, while a near neighbor remains finite.
numeric.mask: Any input NaN, failed pivot or nonfinite Float64 factor masks the entire output group. Any valid source Infinity rejects even beside NoData. Tiny exact nonzero LU factors may round to zero; no invented minimum representability threshold.
numeric.source_free: Finite true-mask constants fold using the same numerical policies, nested casts and finite final-output guard, without inventing grids; masked/singular/nonfinite folds reject.

LU_admission.method: Scalar exponent/significand envelope and key count folded from actual source tiles; precharge exact rational construction/elimination/output work; output rechecks the same envelope before allocating factors. No pixel collect or Input/RDD closure capture. Empty and zero-only envelopes preserve negative exponent bounds.
LU_admission.scope: Actual tile budget-helper and envelope tests; RDD admitSource statically reviewed, not executed. Estimates are not strict CPU-time guarantees.

implementation.modularity: Separate compiler/folding, wire/layout, native numeric/budget and workflow/reference modules; new source files 28 to 254 lines.
